q2: SELECT f1.drinker, f2.drinker FROM frequents AS f1, frequents AS f2 GROUP BY f1.drinker, f2.drinker HAVING COUNT(f1.times_a_week) = COUNT(f2.times_a_week) AND (f1.drinker <> f2.drinker AND f1.drinker < f2.drinker)
